label: S5 route frame is the S4 route frame plus symmetry (inference)
rule: Frame-condition algebra: a reflexive Euclidean relation is transitive and symmetric; a symmetric transitive relation is Euclidean
meaning: Certified difference (#1598) of the registration S5 route frame strengthens S4 route frame: for every profile, the route frame is S5 iff it is S4 and symmetric. Premise-free; it compares the frame conditions and asserts none of them of the route.
